spec.title: Defer tool schemas and build task-relevant agent context
spec.problem: Chat requests send the model every tool schema (about 55 tools, roughly 9,500 tokens) and every domain protocol, even for a simple news question. Implement tool search with deferred full-schema loading inside the existing OpenAI-compatible agent loop: keep a small, locally retrieved initial tool set plus an always-available discovery tool, load full schemas only when the model asks for them, include only the domain instructions the request needs, and place stable definitions before changing state. Preserve company-identity checks, trading validation, source attribution and explicit multi-part requests. Put context selection in backend/context.js.
acceptance_criteria: Common news prompts omit unrelated trading schemas and protocols.
Model-requested searches load only relevant authorized tool definitions.
Discovery can recover from a poor initial match and remains bounded.
Existing company and trading protections remain enforced.
A single requested report finishes without an unnecessary extra model call; multi-part goals can continue.
